themes.counterRead: The divergence is real and worth tracking, not dismissing: GOOGL is 30.5% below its high and META 19.9%, and leadership this concentrated can drag the index if credit flips. But with SPY 1.6% off its high and credit loose, the burden of proof is on the rollover case — a rotation punishes the crowded names, it does not break the market.

The Mag 7 average sits 14.5% below 52-week highs — a 12.9-point divergence gap — while small caps rose: IWM is up 0.38% on the day and 1.61% over the month. themes.counterRead: A 13.57% single-day break on an acute catalyst with RSI 22.3 is narrative running ahead of verified damage — but oversold is not a floor, and the Search-deceleration story can pressure the name for months. There is no buy signal here, only a watch: the entry was missed at higher levels and chasing a bounce into the failure zone is the trap case.
themes.dataAnchor: The move is extreme against any verified damage in the input: GOOGL is 30.5% below its 52-week high with an RSI of 22.3 — deeply oversold — and its dislocation is flagged ACUTE_CATALYST, the only acute-catalyst flag among 30 dislocations. The rest of the book's GOOGL-adjacent names did not confirm a sector break: META is flat on the day (+0.16%) and AMZN is only 15.1% below its high on multiple compression.

themes.watchFor: GOOGL holding above $283.82 on a closing basis with RSI recovering from 22.3, or a further leg down that confirms the deceleration narrative.
